notes.title: Patchnotes 19th April - Life signs
notes.content:
I just wanted to give you a small life sign :) 

Rainware Games still exists and we still care about our games! As most of your we also have to go through hard times. Nevertheless I try my best!

Today I updated FlatFatCat with some small technical changes:

- OSX Version should work again even on the new m1 Mac (tested by myself)
- Windows was updated to 64bit Version
- I couldn't test the linux client – It would be awesome to get some feedback here!

Game changes:

- We have a new ingame background
- There is a new hint in the pause dialog

Steam changes:

- I rewritten all most of the text for the game description
- I added some graphic assets for the game library

Upcoming changes:

- I am currently working on a new trailer which should reflect all changes which have been made through the years

I hope here are still some FlatFatCat fans out there – Thank you very much!

notes.title: Minor Patch 1.6.1 and Linux is now supported!
notes.content:
Hey cat lovers!

For all linux users out there: FlatFatCat is now also available for linux on Steam! Yeah!

Also I have some minor changes in the backpack – Make sure to have a look at the Changelog below

[1.6.1] - 14.01.2019

Added
- Linux is now supported as well
- You are now able to scroll the map with mouse on the right and left edges

Removed
- Removed everything related to Facebook

Changed
- Cleaned up settings window
- Reduced button size on tutorial

notes.title: Version 1.6.0 - Mitch is now available!
notes.content:
Hey fellow cat lovers!

I am proud to announce that Version 1.6.0 is deployed. There are a lot of major changes included. Let me explain some of the biggest changes:


Turn based instead of time based

I had the feeling that the time to finish a level always felt like rushing. You had to play fast and hadn't any time to think about your moves, just at the beginning. With this change you will notice that the whole gameplay changed!

Supercat mode!

If you are able to clear a level before you are out of moves – You will enter supercat mode. Many smaller cat pairs are spawning and won't disappear on contact. So use your moves to generate new Highscores!

All levels are completely redesigned

There were a lot of levels looking very boring and simple. I reviewed every level in detail and tried to make them more enjoyable for everyone.



There are many more minor changes and bug fixes. I hope you enjoy the new version of Flatfatcat and comment your feedback. All changes were applied based on your feedback. I appreciate it a lot keep on bouncing! :)
